description: This header file provides an implementation of a thread-safe 'call_once' mechanism and the 'once_flag' class, used for executing a function exactly once across multiple threads. It includes internal control logic, scheduling helpers, and state management for one-time initialization.

classes.name: once_flag
classes.description: A class used to indicate a one-time initialization point for a function, ensuring it is only executed once across all threads.

methods.name: call_once
methods.description: Executes a given function exactly once for a specific 'once_flag', across all threads. If the function has already been executed, it waits for the execution to complete.
